extraction_warnings: This paper reports aggregate/group-level comparative microbiome data (Yanomami/Brazil n=15, plus reanalyzed published cohorts: Yanomami/Venezuela n=8, Matses n=24, Tunapuco n=12, US n=44); no per-subject demographic table (e.g., age, sex) is included in the provided text, only a reference to Supplementary Table 1.

Fields such as subject_id, sample_id, age, sex, bmi, ancestry, family, dietary_restriction, and disease could not be extracted at the individual level; only qualitative or aggregate statements were available.

Comparator group metadata (country, lifestyle, westernized status) for Yanomami/Venezuela, Matses, Tunapuco, and US groups were not extracted into by_subgroup fields to avoid conflating this study's newly generated cohort (Yanomami/Brazil) with reanalyzed external datasets; users should consult original source papers (Clemente et al., 2015; Obregon-Tito et al., 2015; Human Microbiome Project Consortium, 2012) for those cohorts' detailed metadata.
The 'westernized' and 'disease' field values were inferred rather than directly stated and should be reviewed.

This paper is an observational gut microbiome study of hunter-gatherer/traditional human groups (Yanomami, Matses, Tunapuco, US urban group); it contains no clinical/oncology, FMT, neonatal, or obgyn data relevant to most schema fields.
The schema appears designed for a clinical/oncology or FMT dataset and is largely mismatched with this paper's content (microbiome taxonomic/functional characterization).
Study reports demographic details (age, gender) in Supplementary Table 1, which was not included in the provided text, so age/gender extraction was not possible.

Population-level statements about disease prevalence (e.g., atherosclerosis/obesity 'virtually unknown among Yanomami') were not treated as participant-level disease_details to avoid fabrication/inference beyond what is stated.

study_name, curator, pmid, target_condition, antibiotics_exclusion_period, antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit, tumor_size_residual_measurement, and uncurated_metadata were not explicitly reported in the paper text and were marked as not_reported.

dna_extraction_kit surface form 'FastDNA SPIN Kit (MP Biomedicals)' does not exactly match any single allowed enum value; 'MP Biomedicals' (manufacturer) was used as closest match per instructions to preserve surface form.

sequencing_platform surface form 'HiSeq 2500 sequencer' does not exactly match allowed enum 'Illumina HiSeq' but is preserved verbatim per extraction rules; downstream harmonization should map to Illumina HiSeq.
